title: Cruise Coast NC Rentals, LLC

services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Embrace the freedom of Wake County's waterways with our versatile boat rental options, catering to every type of voyager. Whether you're heart is set on a leisurely cruise with our roomy 22 ft South Bay pontoon, or chasing the thrill of speed on our high-performance speedboats, we have you covered. Our fishing boats are fully outfitted for those angling for a day of reeling in catches, featuring life jackets and optional fishing gear. Prefer a tranquil family outing? Relax on our well-kept pontoon, accommodating up to 12 guests and pet-friendly to boot (see add-ons for pricing). Safety is paramount-our boats come equipped with essentials like life jackets, a blow-horn, and spotlights. Also

includes: Safety gear provided with every rental
Life jackets, blow-horn, spotlights included with boats
Propane grill, tubes, optional slides included with boats
blurb: Cruise & Coast NC Rentals LLC offers private boat and car rentals in Clayton, NC, focusing on value and convenience. Their boat fleet includes pontoons, speedboats, and fishing boats equipped with safety gear and optional fishing equipment. Car rentals include sedans, SUVs, compact cars, and premium vehicles with flexible rental terms and airport pickup service.
